Extra notes
--------------
- If you have determined that an issue is deterministic, and you think you know the root cause, you should figure out what change in testing could have allowed this error to be caught sooner (ideally even before merging the commit to main). If the issue required better testing at the level of the test (for example, a model that didn't properly utilize some ttnn ops) then you should suggest that a unit test should be made to prevent that issue. This is called shifting left, since unit tests run before bigger tests. If that unit test already exists, explain that it needed to be run before merging and it wasn't. If the issue has to do with a bug escape (like a fundamental issue with a ttnn op breaking a model test that didn't do anything wrong) then you should mention that there needs to be new tests written at a lower level. In either case you should outline what should be done, in both the slack message and in the report.
